method: tests/phase4_gbpusd_fixtures.py builds one real, hand-crafted multi-timeframe (D1/H4/H1/M15/M5) GBP/USD candle bundle that drives the unmodified, real production entrypoint (analysis/decision_engine.py::build_decision) through the strict-ICT sequence via strategies/ict_2022_v2.py::analyze_ict_2022_v2 -- not a mocked or hand-built decision dict. Truncating the M15/M5 frames at different points reproduces every earlier waiting state causally, from the same real data. A second bundle (gbpusd_sell_bundle) is an exact price-mirror producing the symmetric SELL sequence. Terminal and plan-validation states (17, 20-24) are proven at the shared contract boundary (analysis/global_overlay_contract.py::normalize_global_decision), the same boundary Volatility 75 uses, consistent with the pattern already established in checkpoints 12 and 15.

real_bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: TypeError: unsupported format string passed to NoneType.__format__
real_bug_found_and_fixed.trigger: A real, reachable production state: M15 context fully resolved (setup/direction/zone known) but M5 has zero completed candles (e.g. a provider gap right after HTF/M15 structure has already formed). analysis/decision_engine.py called build_trade_chart with current_price=None; _distance() correctly returned None, but _message()'s 'waiting_for_m15_area' branch unconditionally formatted that None distance with f'{distance:.1f}', crashing the entire decision instead of returning a degraded-but-safe message. Found empirically while building fixture #15 (waiting for retrace) with an empty M5 frame.
real_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Added a distance-is-None branch returning 'M5 data is unavailable; distance to the M15 context area cannot be projected.' instead of crashing. No other behavior changed.
real_bug_found_and_fixed.regression_status: Covered by test_15_waiting_for_retrace (empty M5, full M15 context) not crashing; full suite re-run confirmed zero regressions.
